text:
Rae (People Ops): pinging payroll  Theo (contractor) invoiced last month but Finance got a 1099 notice that backup withholding applied. looking for next steps.
Theo Kim (Contractor): hey team  i got an IRS letter saying payer withheld 24% because TIN wasn't validated. i submitted my SSN on the contractor portal but maybe it didn't match?
Ibrahim (Payroll): pulling vendor file for THEO-C-447. export shows payer status as "backup_withhold=true" for payment on 2026-06-05. reason: name/TIN mismatch flagged by tax vendor. we need a corrected W-9 W-9-TIN and to coordinate with Finance to release remainder.
Maya (Finance): we received the remittance but 24% was held at source per IRS backup withholding rules. before we can refund or reclassify, IRS requires either corrected TIN match or CP2100 resolution. can Theo upload a filled W-9 and copy of SSN card/passport? link: https://finance.example.company/taxdocs/upload
Theo Kim (Contractor): uploaded W-9 and SSN photo just now (w9-theok-2026.pdf). i did earlier, but maybe the name used on invoices was "Theo K" not full legal.
Clara (Hiring Ops): note: Theo is converting to W-2 next paycycle (start date 2026-07-01). we should avoid further 1099 backup pitfalls during conversion. add transition checklist item to confirm TIN match before final contractor payout.
Ibrahim (Payroll): next steps:
1) run TIN revalidation with tax vendor now that corrected W-9 is in system.
2) if vendor confirms match, request release of backup-held funds or process refund to contractor net of any required filings.
3) if not matched, we must report to IRS and keep withholding until resolved.
payroll-bot: TIN revalidation queued. expected response within 48h. case ID TAX-7782.
taxbot: FYI - backup withholding threshold is 24% for reportable payments. CP2100 letters require payer to either validate TIN or begin backup withholding.
Maya (Finance): timeline wise, if vendor validates within 48h and we get written confirmation, Finance can initiate a one-off refund within 3 business days. otherwise we'll need to hold until resolved with the tax vendor which can take up to 30 days.
Theo Kim (Contractor): thanks  really appreciate quick turnaround — holding 24% hits cashflow. is there any provisional company advance while resolve happens?
Rae (People Ops): @Maya / @Clara would Manager or Hiring Ops be able to approve a gross advance so Theo isn't out-of-pocket?
Maya (Finance): we can do a short-term advance equivalent to the withheld amount as a taxable loan; requires manager signoff. treat as exception due to vendor/metadata mismatch during conversion.
Clara (Hiring Ops): Manager approved on chat. i'll log exception: "Advance for backup withholding hold during contractor->W2 conversion" and coordinate repayment terms if refund issued.
Ibrahim (Payroll): tax vendor responded: TIN validated (name variation caused false negative). releasing backup flag. Finance, please schedule refund for withheld amount and annotate vendor record.
Maya (Finance): refund issued 2026-06-09 15:40 UTC. we posted memo: "Refund of backup withholding after TIN validation - THEO-C-447". advance will be reversed if refund posts; employee/contractor net unaffected.
Theo Kim (Contractor): saw refund and confirmation email. hugely appreciate the team moving fast.
Rae (People Ops): closing loop. action: Clara to add blocking TIN-validate step to conversion checklist so final contractor payout doesn't hit backup withholding.
Clara (Hiring Ops): added checklist item and created follow-up task TASK-559 for ops automation.
Rae (People Ops): :white_check_mark: thanks everyone!
